body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> Innobitz expects to unveil its new handy karaoke 'MUZIO IK100' at upcoming CES 2008 in Las Vegas, USA. The MUZIO IK 100 features an interface to connect it with TV and two-color OLED. It contains approximately 300 songs and you can update new songs using SD memory card slot. It has been exported to Philippine market and the company is anticipating entering USA market with the launch at the trade show.
